title.en: Senjou no Seijo ~Imouto no Kawari ni Koushaku Kishi ni Totsugu Koto ni narimashita ga, Ima wa Shiawase desu~
Gishi no Kawari ni, Yomei Ichinen to Iwareru Koushaku Shisoku-sama to Konyaku suru Koto ni Narimashita
Seijo no Ane desu ga, Naze ka Miwaku no Koushaku-sama ni Tsukaeru Koto ni narimashita
"Omae ga Kawari ni Shine" to Iwareta Watashi. Imouto no Migawari ni Reikoku na Henkyou Haku no Moto e Totsugi, Shiawase wo Teniireru
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Kao ga Miwakerarenai Hakushaku Reijou Desu ga, Akunin Koushaku-sama ni Dekiai Sarete Imasu
Watashi, Seijo. Ima, Kankinsarete Iru no
Tsuihou Sareta Kishi Suki Seijo wa Kyou mo Shiawase
Seijo ni Naritai Wake de wa Arimasen ga Henkyou kara Kita Inaka Musume nanoni Ou Taishi-hi Kouho ni Erabarete Shimaimashita!?
Konyaku haki sareta muhyoujou reijou ga shiawase ni naru made ~Kinmusaki no tennen tarashi kishidan-chou-sama ga torottoro ni amayakashite dekiai shite kuru no desu ga!?~
Kuro Tsubasa no Koutei wa Tou no Ue no Imi Seijo o Dekiai Suru
Koishita Hito wa, Imouto no Kawari ni Shindekure to Itta
Kore kara Shiawase ni narimasu! Shiitagerare Reijou desu ga Tekitaikoku no Koushaku-sama ni Naze ka Dekiaisaretemasu
Kokurou Ou to Shirogane no Niehime
Do Majime Jijo no Kon'yaku Soudou! ~Mukuchina Kishi-dan fuku Danchou ni Jitsuwa Betabore Saretemashita~
Keiyakukon shita Aite ga Oni Saishoudeshitaga, Kono-do Saishou-shitsu Sennin Hosa-kan ni Ninmei sareta Jimi Bunkan (Hensouchuu) wa Watashidesu
